title: Material Turnover Inconsistency Between Balance Sheet and Bid Declaration
ai_recommendation: CRITICAL RISK: Direct conflict between audited revenue and statutory declaration. Manual CA verification required; recommend issuance of Show-Cause / Ineligibility Clarification.
summary: Audited Balance Sheet submitted in Doc #04 reports FY 2024-25 revenue of ₹12,40,00,000, whereas Bidder Self-Declaration in Doc #09 explicitly declares turnover as ₹8,20,00,000 (which falls below the mandatory tender threshold of ₹10,00,00,000). The gap of ₹4,20,00,000 represents a material contradiction.

evidence_excerpts.extracted_text: Schedule 18 — Revenue from Operations: Total Turnover for Year Ended 31st March 2025: INR 12,40,00,000 (Twelve Crore Forty Lakhs Only)
Item 4(b) — We hereby confirm our certified annual turnover for FY 2024-25 as INR 8,20,00,000 (Eight Crore Twenty Lakhs Only) under GeM guidelines.

title: BIS Quality License Expired 3 Months Prior to Bid Submission Date
ai_recommendation: NON-COMPLIANT ON BID DATE: Certificate validity expired on 09-Jun-2026. Bid was submitted on 14-Sep-2026 (Deadline 15-Sep-2026). Bidder submitted a subsequent renewal receipt dated 28-Sep-2026 which does not cure non-compliance on submission date.
summary: Tender Clause 5.2 mandates that the product offered must carry a valid BIS License active on the bid submission date (15-Sep-2026). Bureau of Indian Standards License CM/L-8472910 expired on 09-Jun-2026, creating a 98-day validity lapse during the active bidding window.

evidence_excerpts.extracted_text: License Validity Period: From 10/01/2023 to 09/06/2026 (Midnight). Endorsement for renewal required prior to expiry.

title: Make in India Local Content Discrepancy (62.4% Declared vs 48.0% Itemized)
ai_recommendation: RECOMMEND REVIEW: Calculated domestic value addition from Bill of Materials is 48.0%, which falls below Class-I threshold (50%). Auditor declaration of 62.4% includes imported actuator assembly overheads.
summary: Auditor Certificate claims 62.4% local content, qualifying bidder as Class-I Local Supplier. However, detailed component Bill of Materials (BoM Annexure III) shows imported hydraulic actuators from Germany representing 52.0% of CIF raw value, yielding a maximum domestic value of 48.0%.
